headline: Ethiopia: Economic and financial reforms are moving the country from stabilisation to economic transformation - Deputy Prime Minister Temesgen
summary: Deputy Prime Minister Temesgen Tiruneh said Ethiopia is carrying out economic and financial reforms to move from a stabilisation phase to economic transformation.
why: Ethiopia's reform programme shapes its macroeconomic stability, foreign investment climate and debt negotiations.
